# gravitino_user Resource



## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "gravitino_user" "example" {
  # ... example configuration ...
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The user name.

### Optional

- `roles` (List of String) The roles assigned to the user.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format 'metalake.user_name'.
